title: BSTN × Sneaker LAB
intro: Two distinct identities. One shared language of basketball, streetwear and sneaker care. A proposed packaging sleeve that brings them together.

sources.label: RANDOM-ORDER-X-HA / V2 / Build Experiment Test / Sneaker LAB × BSTN / Pitch
RANDOM-HOTEL / Workbench / BSTN × Sneaker LAB pitch

blocks.label: The brief
blocks.body: How can two brands with different purposes create something that feels entirely their own? The brief explored a care-kit sleeve that connects Sneaker LAB’s product expertise with BSTN’s roots in basketball and streetwear.

blocks.label: Thinking Unity
blocks.body: Thinking Unity. Rather than placing two identities side by side, the concept finds common ground in the culture surrounding the product. The basketball court provides the organising idea: a graphic language of lines, rhythm, movement and connection.

blocks.label: The visual direction
blocks.body: Court markings become packaging architecture. Bold monochrome graphics, orange-court studies and a restrained typographic system translate the energy of the game into a sleeve designed for sneaker culture. Presented as a pitch concept, not a released product.
